description: This is a Lua script intended for a graphics or 3D rendering context. It sets up a window, loads a 3D model, and renders it with interactive controls.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the graphics window, loads a 3D model, and enables debug mode.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the scene including background, camera controls, and the 3D model with transformations.
